descricao:
Provides access to metadata stored for every available engine class.
Note: Script-defined classes with class_name are not part of ClassDB, so they will not return reflection data such as a method or property list. However, GDExtension-defined classes are part of ClassDB, so they will return reflection data.

metodos.assinatura: can_instantiate(class: StringName) -> bool const
metodos.desc: Returns true if objects can be instantiated from the specified 'class', otherwise returns false.

metodos.assinatura: class_call_static(class: StringName, method: StringName) -> Variant vararg
metodos.desc: Calls a static method on a class.

metodos.assinatura: class_exists(class: StringName) -> bool const
metodos.desc: Returns whether the specified 'class' is available or not.

metodos.assinatura: class_get_api_type(class: StringName) -> ClassDB.APIType const
metodos.desc: Returns the API type of the specified 'class'.

metodos.assinatura: class_get_enum_constants(class: StringName, enum: StringName, no_inheritance: bool = false) -> PackedStringArray const
metodos.desc: Returns an array with all the keys in 'enum' of 'class' or its ancestry.

metodos.assinatura: class_get_enum_list(class: StringName, no_inheritance: bool = false) -> PackedStringArray const
metodos.desc: Returns an array with all the enums of 'class' or its ancestry.

metodos.assinatura: class_get_integer_constant(class: StringName, name: StringName) -> int const
metodos.desc: Returns the value of the integer constant 'name' of 'class' or its ancestry. Always returns 0 when the constant could not be found.

metodos.assinatura: class_get_integer_constant_enum(class: StringName, name: StringName, no_inheritance: bool = false) -> StringName const
metodos.desc: Returns which enum the integer constant 'name' of 'class' or its ancestry belongs to.

metodos.assinatura: class_get_integer_constant_list(class: StringName, no_inheritance: bool = false) -> PackedStringArray const
metodos.desc: Returns an array with the names all the integer constants of 'class' or its ancestry.

metodos.assinatura: class_get_method_argument_count(class: StringName, method: StringName, no_inheritance: bool = false) -> int const
metodos.desc: Returns the number of arguments of the method 'method' of 'class' or its ancestry if 'no_inheritance' is false.

metodos.assinatura: class_get_method_list(class: StringName, no_inheritance: bool = false) -> Dictionary[] const
metodos.desc:
Returns an array with all the methods of 'class' or its ancestry if 'no_inheritance' is false. Every element of the array is a Dictionary with the following keys: args, default_args, flags, id, name, return: (class_name, hint, hint_string, name, type, usage).
Note: In exported release builds the debug info is not available, so the returned dictionaries will contain only method names.

metodos.assinatura: class_get_property(object: Object, property: StringName) -> Variant const
metodos.desc: Returns the value of 'property' of 'object' or its ancestry.

metodos.assinatura: class_get_property_default_value(class: StringName, property: StringName) -> Variant const
metodos.desc: Returns the default value of 'property' of 'class' or its ancestor classes.

metodos.assinatura: class_get_property_getter(class: StringName, property: StringName) -> StringName
metodos.desc: Returns the getter method name of 'property' of 'class'.

metodos.assinatura: class_get_property_list(class: StringName, no_inheritance: bool = false) -> Dictionary[] const
metodos.desc: Returns an array with all the properties of 'class' or its ancestry if 'no_inheritance' is false.

metodos.assinatura: class_get_property_setter(class: StringName, property: StringName) -> StringName
metodos.desc: Returns the setter method name of 'property' of 'class'.

metodos.assinatura: class_get_signal(class: StringName, signal: StringName) -> Dictionary const
metodos.desc: Returns the 'signal' data of 'class' or its ancestry. The returned value is a Dictionary with the following keys: args, default_args, flags, id, name, return: (class_name, hint, hint_string, name, type, usage).

metodos.assinatura: class_get_signal_list(class: StringName, no_inheritance: bool = false) -> Dictionary[] const
metodos.desc: Returns an array with all the signals of 'class' or its ancestry if 'no_inheritance' is false. Every element of the array is a Dictionary as described in 'class_get_signal'.

metodos.assinatura: class_has_enum(class: StringName, name: StringName, no_inheritance: bool = false) -> bool const
metodos.desc: Returns whether 'class' or its ancestry has an enum called 'name' or not.

metodos.assinatura: class_has_integer_constant(class: StringName, name: StringName) -> bool const
metodos.desc: Returns whether 'class' or its ancestry has an integer constant called 'name' or not.

metodos.assinatura: class_has_method(class: StringName, method: StringName, no_inheritance: bool = false) -> bool const
metodos.desc: Returns whether 'class' (or its ancestry if 'no_inheritance' is false) has a method called 'method' or not.

metodos.assinatura: class_has_signal(class: StringName, signal: StringName) -> bool const
metodos.desc: Returns whether 'class' or its ancestry has a signal called 'signal' or not.

metodos.assinatura: class_set_property(object: Object, property: StringName, value: Variant) -> Error const
metodos.desc: Sets 'property' value of 'object' to 'value'.

metodos.assinatura: get_class_list() -> PackedStringArray const
metodos.desc:
Returns the names of all engine classes available.
Note: Script-defined classes with class_name are not included in this list. Use 'ProjectSettings.get_global_class_list' to get a list of script-defined classes instead.

metodos.assinatura: get_inheriters_from_class(class: StringName) -> PackedStringArray const
metodos.desc: Returns the names of all engine classes that directly or indirectly inherit from 'class'.

metodos.assinatura: get_parent_class(class: StringName) -> StringName const
metodos.desc: Returns the parent class of 'class'.

metodos.assinatura: instantiate(class: StringName) -> Variant const
metodos.desc: Creates an instance of 'class'.

metodos.assinatura: is_class_enabled(class: StringName) -> bool const
metodos.desc: Returns whether this 'class' is enabled or not.

metodos.assinatura: is_class_enum_bitfield(class: StringName, enum: StringName, no_inheritance: bool = false) -> bool const
metodos.desc: Returns whether 'class' (or its ancestor classes if 'no_inheritance' is false) has an enum called 'enum' that is a bitfield.

metodos.assinatura: is_parent_class(class: StringName, inherits: StringName) -> bool const
metodos.desc: Returns whether 'inherits' is an ancestor of 'class' or not.
